[SWS_DM_01959] Availability of internal data element Internal Data Element
DEM_CYCLES_TESTED_SINCE_FIRST_FAILED
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
The DM shall support the
internal data element
DEM_CYCLES_TESTED_SINCE_FIRST_FAILED
only for stored events.
⌋

DTC
s

DTC group

tus byte

snapshot records

data records
and further DTC-related data.
